Package edu.mit.rocket_team.util.data

Class RTMagData

java.lang.Object
edu.mit.rocket_team.util.data.RTFudgedData
edu.mit.rocket_team.util.data.RTMagData
public class RTMagData extends RTFudgedData
Mutable legacy magnetometer readings and externally supplied roll angle; no calibrated sensor model is implied.
